title: Implement the Grok Bot adapter
description:
Implement the Grok Bot adapter per the shared adapter contract: discovery of its conversation store, human-message extraction with injected-content exclusion, session and project attribution, and emission of the normalized record with source grok-bot.

Done when: golden extraction tests pass on the synthetic fixtures; the adapter streams and never loads whole stores.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: BLOCKED on KDATAP-a1a9d4: the adapter needs the researched storage format and synthetic fixtures first. Implementation plan when unblocked: create src/sentiment/adapters/grok-bot.ts implementing the SentimentAdapter contract (sync discover() with SkipCounter, async-iterable extract() yielding Zod HumanMessageRecord with source "grok-bot"), streaming reads (never load whole stores), injected-content exclusion mirroring the other adapters, and a doctorGrokBot in the style of doctorClaudeCode/doctorCursor/doctorCodex. The shared record/dedup/scan-state frameworks are ready and adapter-source-agnostic.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Done (commit 9daf7b3). New adapter src/sentiment/adapters/grok-bot.ts implementing the SentimentAdapter contract:
- discover(): decodes base32 blob filenames, keeps only keys ending .transcript.replicas.<conversation-uuid>, tolerates missing roots.
- extract(): counts kind=message role=user WITHOUT fromAgent (plain + fromUser) per the f66d10 rule; skips send-message/assistant/voice-call/event; unknown kinds counted in skipCounter.unknownRecords; empty content or missing timestampMs counted as malformed; epoch-ms timestamps normalized to RFC 3339 UTC; record ids embed the conversation uuid so per-conversation-local ids (t0s0, tbs0 reuse across conversations, pinned on the real corpus) never collide or collapse.
- Unparseable blobs throw and are recorded per-file by the scan guard (scan continues).
- doctorGrokBot(): blobCount/transcriptBlobCount/issues, counts only.
- runSentimentMeter: grok-bot added to default sources; tests/unit/sentiment/grok-bot.spec.ts covers decoding, discovery, extraction, cross-conversation dedup, doctor, meter integration. 15/15 sentiment suites green (146 tests).
